d:
After the Republicans suffered a major setback in the US midterm elections, Donald Trump has indicated that the possibility of renewed military action against Iran is very low if negotiations make progress. However, he has kept the military option open, saying US forces are prepared and key Iranian infrastructure remains on the target list. Is Trump moving towards a deal with Tehran, or is the threat of another round of strikes still alive?
Production: Akankshya Gogoi
Video Editor: Satyam Sharma
